shots.note: medium push_in: Narada stands with his veena in Vishnu's bright blue-gold hall below the title card; he lifts his hand in greeting on 'sage' as soft rays fall on him.
two_shot pan_right: The window pans from Narada, hands raised in a question, to blue Vishnu, who turns to him with a knowing smile as 'Maya' is said and a violet glow stirs behind him.
close static: Close on Vishnu: he gives no lecture, only a calm smile, and on 'water' he holds out an open, empty hand.
medium pull_out: Narada stands alone with empty open hands in a hall turning violet; on 'answer' a pale halo ring opens behind him, the riddle he does not yet understand.
establishing crane_down: Wide on Vaikuntha: a gold temple gateway shines on the clouds and Narada walks in with his veena; the name plate appears as 'Vaikuntha' is said.
medium push_in: Narada talks eagerly with an open hand; behind him a faint memory of Brahma glows in a rose light, the father his curse came true on.
medium tilt_up: Vishnu smiles knowingly; on 'Maya' a violet swirl of light turns behind him and the sky softens to violet.
close push_in: Close on Narada's face: brows knit in doubt, head tilted, eyes on Vishnu as he asks.
medium dolly_left: Vishnu, still smiling, opens his empty hand toward Narada as he says he is thirsty, his eyes on the sage.
two_shot pan_left: The window pans from Vishnu pointing out of his hall on 'fetch' to Narada, who bows with folded hands on 'answer', ready to go.
wide dolly_right: A bright morning river valley: Narada walks along the sandy bank with his veena, the blue river winding behind him.
two_shot pan_right: The window pans from Narada, who stops in surprise, to the young woman in a rose sari standing by the water.
close push_in: Close on her face: a shy smile, eyes lowered, a warm rose glow and a halo of light behind her head.
medium pull_out: Narada gazes at her with a dreamy smile while a faint image of Vishnu behind him fades into mist on 'Vishnu' and is gone by 'thirst'.
two_shot push_in: Narada, now a householder in a yellow shawl, and the young woman fold their hands to each other as husband and wife inside a ring of marigold light.
wide crane_up: Wide: a thatched mud house stands on the sand with the river behind it; Narada opens his arms to show it and his wife smiles at the door.
wide dolly_left: The same house through the seasons: pink spring blossoms drift down, while from 'Years' the sky turns to golden autumn and the light deepens.
medium push_in: Narada the householder stands before his house with his little son and daughter, opening his arms to them with joy on 'father'.
medium static: A cross-fade in the same place: Narada is now white-bearded and old, the sky has turned autumn gold, and two small grandchildren stand at his side.
wide pull_out: Old Narada stands before his lamp-lit house with his wife and the children around him; a warm ring of light circles the house: everything he has is here.
medium tilt_up: Old Narada looks up in unease as the bright sky over the river cross-fades to gray from 'day' to 'gray'.
wide handheld: Rain streaks over the house; a lightning fork flashes far in the sky on 'Thunder', and on 'flooded' a big paper wave of river water rises at the bank as the family huddles.
medium dolly_right: A great blue wave rolls across; his wife and children slide away into the water and fade, while old Narada reaches after them in grief.
two_shot crane_down: A white flash and the storm is gone: stacked, Vishnu above in the bright hall smiles; below, young Narada with his veena stands blinking in surprise.
medium push_in: Vishnu holds out his empty open hand and asks with a gentle teasing smile; his eyes rest on Narada.
close static: Close on Narada's face staring straight ahead, mouth open in shock, a pale ring of light behind his head: he understands no time has passed.
wide pull_out: A violet dream: his wife, then his son and daughter float faintly in the mist beside the house as each is named, then dissolve away on 'none'.
medium tilt_down: Vishnu speaks with an open teaching hand inside a violet swirl; the name 'Maya' appears and on 'last' a small faint house drifts behind him and is gone.
medium dolly_left: Young Narada on the empty river bank reaches out; a stream of golden sand blows out of his open hands and away from him.
wide pull_out: Vishnu smiles warmly and raises a warning hand on 'warned'; a violet swirl and halo open behind him on 'Maya' as the camera pulls away.
